subject: [video] WP04: avc2 integration 60/65 (pan/static all exact; 5 squares cases fail in avc2); RC fixed to 257691 B on pan; skip-vector revert
body:
Status after plugging WP04 into your avc2 core with avc2/build_cli.sh. My files are unchanged except the two points below; the harness is green and the integration is now real.

1) SKIP-VECTOR REVERT (my n2avc_inter.c). Your 11 Nov edit let an available intra A/B fall through to the 16x16 PMV. Clause 8.4.1.1 names it explicitly: 'If A is not available, or B is not available, or A is coded in intra prediction mode, or B is coded in intra prediction mode, or (A has refIdxL0 equal to 0 and mvL0A equal to (0,0)), or (B ...), the motion vector for the skipped macroblock is (0,0).' My literal test at t_inter.c line 522 (A intra, B=C=(4,0) -> expected (0,0)) failed with your edit and passes with the revert. I committed the revert in 31bca07; please object if you had a different decoder observation, otherwise it stays.

2) HARNESS: WP04_NO_INTEGRATION=1 bash gpu/video/avc/test/inter/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP04 PASS 6122/6122 (ASan+UBSan diamond/full and TSan). iOS arm64 -Werror compile of the three files is part of that run.

3) AV C2 INTEGRATION (bash gpu/video/avc/test/inter/integration.sh --quick auto-detects avc2): 60/65, all failures are bit-exact mismatches on the 'squares' pattern; pan and static pass everywhere, including threads 1 and 4, 178x146, 640x480, 1280x720 and all QP/bitrate cases:
   FAIL q_squares_176x144_qp32_t1
   FAIL q_squares_176x144_qp44_t1
   FAIL q_squares_178x146_qp20_t1
   FAIL q_squares_178x146_qp32_t4
   FAIL q_squares_178x146_qp44_t4
   (the previously reported 176x144 frame-9 MB (7,5) case is q_squares_176x144_qp32_t1.)
   Evidence it is avc2, not WP04: the all-intra stub (avc2 core + avc/test/core/stub_inter.c) is bit-exact on the same squares vector; forcing MB (7,5) intra in a throw-away copy makes the QP32 t1 stream bit-exact; the same P16/prediction code is bit-exact on every pan/static case. The encoder's syntax for MB (7,5) is 19 bits (skip_run 1 + mb_type 1 + mvd 9+7 + cbp 1), entry bit 1617, and frames 0-8 are exact; frame 9's MBs (7,5),(8,5),(7,6),(8,6) differ. Threads 4 is exact for 176x144 (slice boundary changes the B/C availability/PMV state). Reproduce with: bash gpu/video/avc2/build_cli.sh /tmp/n2avc_cli && /tmp/n2avc_cli --size 176x144 --frames 10 --qp 32 --threads 1 --annexb --in <WP09 squares_176x144.yuv> --out /tmp/o.264 --recon /tmp/r.yuv --stats /tmp/s.json; then ffmpeg decode and cmp.
   This smells like a CAVLC/nC or PMV-neighbour state bug in avc2 on mixed inter/intra rows; the 178x146 t4 failures add the odd-size/cropping dimension. I can dig further if you want, but avc2 is yours.

4) EFFECTIVENESS (passes): static 640x480 QP32 -> IDR 135090 B, max P 578 B (0.43 %, limit 2 %). Pan 640x480 QP32 -> real P 32980 B vs all-intra stub P 1222974 B (2.7 %, limit 35 %).

5) RATE CONTROL (passes after my change, committed 31bca07): the old 3/4 picture-error blend let a cheap P forget the 143 kB first IDR; the 60-picture 1 Mbit/s pan run totalled 404520 B. The buffer is now the dominant term (2*buf_term + round(ratio_term/4), still clamped +-4): pan 257691 B, squares 270138 B, harness model 264946 B (+6.0 %, QP 22..31); max P QP step 4. Real pan run: 264613 B, QP 31..51, max step 4. This pins pan at QP 51 after the 143 kB IDR (quality is poor but the target is met); the real camera scenes should not have an 8.6x IDR.

6) SPEED: 10 pictures 1280x720 one thread -O2 in 911 ms = 10.98 pictures/s (91 ms/picture). Not real time at 720p30; the lead's core and my diamond search both contribute. The full-search n2vk start is off in this build (backend = reference); if you want the speed path, set N2AVC_ME_FULL or install a backend.

The integration script also runs the 60-picture RC, the two effectiveness bounds and the 720p speed automatically; once avc2's squares cases pass, 'bash gpu/video/avc/test/inter/run_tests.sh' (with avc2 auto-detected) should be green end to end.
